jobs.description:
Pay Range:
Targeted salary of $10.00/hour, based on education and experience.

Benefits Eligible:
No

Work Schedule

Approximately 10–20 hours per week.
The supervisor will work with each student employee to establish a schedule that accommodates their class schedule.

Travel:
Not required

Position Introduction

The Dodge Family College of Arts and Sciences Dean's Office is seeking two undergraduate students to join its Data Analysis team as Student Data Analysts.

This position provides students with practical experience in data analysis, research, reporting, and data visualization. Student Data Analysts will work with institutional data and support projects that inform decision-making across the College. Students will receive hands-on training and regular guidance as they develop skills in Excel, Power BI, data validation, analytical reasoning, and professional communication.

We are especially interested in students who would like to remain in the position for multiple semesters, allowing them to continue developing their skills and take on increasingly independent work.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain reports, dashboards, charts, and analytical models using Excel and Power BI.
Retrieve, organize, review, and validate institutional data.
Assist with enrollment, student, academic program, and other College-level analyses.
Respond to data and reporting requests from departments and Dean's Office leadership.
Research and investigate unexpected trends or inconsistencies in data.
Learn to query databases and work with institutional data sources.
Document data sources, calculations, assumptions, and analytical methods.
Summarize findings in clear language for non-technical audiences.
Assist with longer-term analytical projects from initial research through final presentation.
Manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
Handle confidential student and personnel information in accordance with FERPA and University policies.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

Student analysts will learn to answer three important questions about their work:

How did you arrive at that number?
Where did the data come from?
How do we know it's right?

What You'll Learn

Develop advanced Excel and Power BI skills.
Learn how professional analysts approach and validate data.
Work with real-world datasets and business questions.
Improve analytical writing and data visualization skills.
Present findings to College leadership and departmental administrators.
Complete projects that can be discussed in future job or graduate school interviews.
Receive regular feedback and professional development from the Executive Director.

Students who demonstrate strong performance and increased proficiency may be considered for additional responsibilities and advancement opportunities, subject to University processes and available funding.

Students from all DFCAS majors are encouraged to apply. Advanced data-analysis experience is not required. We are looking for students who are curious, careful, willing to learn, and interested in understanding not only what the numbers show, but why. Students with at least two semesters remaining at OU are especially encouraged to apply.

Selection Process

We want to see how you like to solve problems. The interview includes a short data-analysis exercise: you'll build a simple chart and write a brief interpretation of the data, and then we'll talk through it together. We're evaluating analytical thinking, attention to detail, and communication — not advanced Excel skills, and not how you perform under pressure. If you need help with Excel, just ask.

Use Of AI

AI tools may be used as part of the application process, interview exercise, and position when appropriate.

Applicants should be prepared to explain how they used AI and how they reviewed or verified its output. AI is considered a tool to support analytical work, not a replacement for independent judgment.

All use of AI while working with University information must comply with applicable University requirements regarding confidentiality, FERPA, information security, and institutional data.

Required Education And Experience

Must be currently enrolled in the Fall Term as a student at the University of Oklahoma.

Hiring contingent upon verification of current student status.

Must be a student in the Dodge Family College of Arts and Sciences.

Skills

Basic familiarity with Microsoft Excel.
Strong written communication skills.
Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to think critically and solve problems.
Ability to learn new software and analytical methods.
Ability to maintain confidentiality.
Ability to maintain a consistent weekly work schedule.

Coursework or experience in one or more of the following areas is helpful but not required:

Statistics
Economics
Research methods
Data analysis
Quantitative reasoning
Computer science or programming
Business analytics
Social science research
Research and analytical writing

Job Title: eCommerce Data Analyst 

Location: Fayetteville, AR (In-Person, Full-Time)

About Benton Lane

Benton Lane is a fast-growing family of eCommerce brands creating beautiful products for the home. Our portfolio includes Painted Paper, Lemon Park, Aspen&Arlo, Hillcroft Home, and other growing brands across home and gift.

We’re a small, ambitious team working at the intersection of eCommerce, design, technology, AI, and physical production. We manufacture in the U.S., operate multiple brands, and use technology to move faster—from custom Shopify experiences to internal automation and AI-powered workflows.

This is a startup-style environment: priorities move quickly, good ideas get implemented, and individual contributors have a meaningful impact on how the company operates.

This role is the data seat on our team. Your work will help answer some of the most important questions in the business: What should we make more of? What should we stop making? Where are we growing? Where are we losing margin? And where should we invest next?

What You’ll Do

Own reporting and data discovery across our brands. You’ll model data, build useful views and dashboards, and help determine which metrics deserve the attention of leadership and our technology team.
Turn ERP data into business decisions. You’ll spend significant time working with the data behind our products, orders, inventory, production, and operations—finding patterns and answering real questions with numbers.
Bring our data together. Build and maintain pipelines that connect Shopify, Klaviyo, Fulfil (our ERP), and other systems into a reliable source of truth.
Dig deeper than the dashboard. Investigate anomalies, test assumptions, and perform ad hoc analysis when the business needs an answer—not just another report.
Use AI as part of your everyday toolkit. Use LLMs to accelerate querying and analysis, classify messy information, extract structure from unstructured data, and build evaluations that verify AI-generated outputs before the business relies on them.
Build trust in the numbers. Catch the confident wrong answer—whether it came from a person, a dashboard, a query, or a model.
Help shape how Benton Lane uses data. We’re still building. You’ll have the opportunity to influence our data models, reporting standards, tools, workflows, and how teams across the company make decisions.

What We’re Looking For

You don’t need to check every box. We care about curiosity, judgment, and the ability to figure things out.

2–5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role
Strong SQL skills and comfort working directly with relational data
Experience extracting and working with data from REST APIs
Experience with Shopify, Klaviyo, ERP systems, or similar eCommerce platforms is a plus
Experience building dashboards in a BI tool such as Looker, Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI—we care more about your judgment than which tool you’ve used
Hands-on experience using AI in analytical work, whether through LLM-assisted querying and analysis, agentic tools, data classification/extraction, or preparing data for AI systems
Strong analytical instincts and a willingness to question results that don’t make sense
Ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical teammates
Experience with eCommerce, retail, inventory, manufacturing, or product data is a plus

You’ll Probably Thrive Here If You…

Like getting into messy data and figuring out what’s actually going on
Are comfortable moving between SQL, dashboards, APIs, spreadsheets, and AI tools
Ask “does this number make sense?” before presenting it
Can balance speed with accuracy
Want ownership early and are excited to help build systems rather than inherit finished ones

Why This Role Is Different

You’ll be close to the decisions. You’ll work directly with our CTO and company leadership, and your analysis will influence product, marketing, inventory, production, and investment decisions.
You’ll see the whole business. Because we’re vertically integrated, our data spans the customer journey from marketing and eCommerce through manufacturing, inventory, fulfillment, and financial performance.
You’ll get to build, not just maintain. Our data stack and AI workflows are evolving quickly. You’ll have significant input into what we build next and how we build it.
Your work will have visible impact. This isn’t a role where analysis disappears into a slide deck. The goal is to turn data into better decisions—and then see those decisions play out across the business.

We’re looking for someone who wants to join the team and build with us. We are not considering agencies, contractors, or third-party service providers for this position.

What We’re Looking For

You don’t need to check every box. We care about curiosity, judgment, and the ability to figure things out.

2–5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role
Strong SQL skills and comfort working directly with relational data
Experience extracting and working with data from REST APIs
Experience with Shopify, Klaviyo, ERP systems, or similar eCommerce platforms is a plus
Experience building dashboards in a BI tool such as Looker, Metabase, Tableau, or Power BI—we care more about your judgment than which tool you’ve used

Like getting into messy data and figuring out what’s actually going on

Maintains a clean, organized, and safe gymnastics/ninja environment while ensuring equipment and facility standards are met.

Supports hiring, onboarding, training, and ongoing development of gymnastics and ninja team members.

Creative problem-solving skills with strong verbal and written communication abilities.
